instruction: A city park pond in full autumn: maples and ginkgos in red, orange and gold, leaves spiraling down onto the water, a curved stone bridge, a green bench beside a cast-iron lamppost, a duck family gliding, drifting leaf rafts, a gravel path with scattered leaves, and low golden light through the branches.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Autumn Park Pond. A city park pond in full autumn: maples and ginkgos in red, orange and gold, leaves spiraling down onto the water, a curved stone bridge, a green bench beside a cast-iron lamppost, a duck family gliding, drifting leaf rafts, a gravel path with scattered leaves, and low golden light through the branches. Style: warm impressionist. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
